text: Sorting and grouping combinators compute the key once per record rather than per comparison, because get may be a disk read plus a parse. group_by returns an IndexMap so grouping hits by query reports queries in file order. Every other combinator is eager: walk 0..len() once, build a vector of indices, return View<I> holding the inner collection and that permutation; View is Indexable so combinators chain, and &I is Indexable so one collection can be adapted more than once without being consumed.
